The proposed solution contains multiple fundamental errors (e.g., claiming $\dim \mathfrak{sl}_3 = 6$, that all nilpotent orbits are closed, confusing the minimal nilpotent orbit with the regular one, etc.) and reaches an incorrect final formula.

By dimension considerations alone:
- The minimal nilpotent orbit $\mathbb{O}_n \subset \mathfrak{sl}_n$ has complex dimension $2n - 2$, so its cotangent bundle $T^*\mathbb{O}_n$ (and its affine closure) has dimension $4n - 4$.
- The minimal nilpotent orbit closure in $\mathfrak{so}_m$ has dimension $2m - 6$.
- A $\mathbb{C}^*$-Hamiltonian reduction reduces the dimension by $2$, yielding a variety of dimension $(2m - 6) - 2 = 2m - 8$.

Equating $2m - 8 = 4n - 4$ gives $m = 2n + 2$, which contradicts the proposed answer of $2n - 1$.

VERDICT: REJECT
